typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Member_First_Name as string,
		Member_Middle_Initial as string,
		Member_Last_Name as string,
		Member_Id as string,
		Member_Medicaid_Id as string,
		Member_DOB as string,
		Tax_ID as string,
		Health_Center as string,
		Member_Gender as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT   [Member_First_Name] 		,[Member_Middle_Initial]  		,[Member_Last_Name]  		,[Member_Id]  		,[Member_Medicaid_Id]  		,[Member_DOB]  		,[Tax_ID]  		,[Health_Center]  		,[Member_Gender] FROM EXTRACT.DCPCA_MEMBER_EXTRACT',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> EXTRACTDATA
EXTRACTDATA derive({Copy of Member_Middle_Initial} = toString(Member_Middle_Initial),
		{Copy of Member_Medicaid_Id} = toString(Member_Medicaid_Id),
		{Copy of Member_Id} = toString(Member_Id),
		{Copy of Member_Last_Name} = toString(Member_Last_Name),
		{Copy of Health_Center} = toString(Health_Center),
		{Copy of Member_Gender} = toString(Member_Gender),
		{Copy of Member_First_Name} = toString(Member_First_Name),
		{Copy of Tax_ID} = toString(Tax_ID),
		{Copy of Member_DOB} = toString(Member_DOB)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
